column2: Antlion hatchlings swarm the fields in front of the outpost.
Weak skeletons rise from the graves in the fields.
In the middle of the fields lurks an unusually large antlion.
The southern end of the fields. Watch the warnings on the ground and dodge.
Get an empty plot from Guard Captain Hagen and build a Smithy. The Smithy enhances gear and salvages gear you don't use.
Enhance a piece of gear to +{} at the Smithy. Failure never lowers the level; Artisan's Spirit builds up instead.
Zones whose boss you've defeated open a dungeon entrance (green triangle on the minimap). Take this key and defeat the boss at the deepest point of the Fields dungeon.
Goblin scouts in the western woods have cut off the road.
Hobgoblins have set up camp in the woods.
Build a Herb Field. Herbs grow on their own over time and become potions · crafting materials.
Dodge his charge to the side.
Build an Inn and Lodging and hire a visiting mercenary. Mercenaries work in buildings and go on expeditions.

A horde has gathered in a zone whose boss you've defeated. Talk to me to head to the battlefield. Survive the waves, destroy the three war banners, then defeat the Horde Captain. Leave it be and hunting ground loot will drop.
Skeletons rise in the northern graveyard.
The priest at the heart of the graveyard.

Monsters have flooded a zone left alone too long (red zone on the minimap). Portals can't reach it, so walk there. Entering traps you in a barrier; defeat all flood monsters and the flood boss to purify it. A new one appears every evening at {} o'clock.
Raiders have taken the eastern citadel.
Fire ants are burning the walls.
The end of the first chapter.
Build an Expedition Hall and send mercenaries to a zone. They bring back gold · gear · materials. At the hall you can choose to take or salvage incoming items.
Build a Mine. Enhancement stones pile up on their own. It stops when full, so collect now and then.
Packs of fishmen swarm the southwestern swamp.
Vipers hold the road across the swamp.
A fog-calling shaman lives at the heart of the swamp.
The deepest part of the swamp. Dodge the charges and spores.
Build a Workshop. It turns herbs into potions · elixirs and also makes empowered dungeon keys · greater enhancement stones.
Build a Laboratory and start a research. Research permanently improves abilities with gold and time.
Analyzing unknown map fragments at the Laboratory reveals rumors. Take this rumor, roam that zone, find the hidden dungeon entrance and clear it.
Frozen zombies walk the northwestern highlands.
A swarm of ice ants blocks the road.
A revenant wandering the highlands. Its charge is fast.
The king before the ice cave.
Antlions hunting in packs in the northeastern canyon.
Armored antlions have blocked the canyon entrance.
The old minotaur at the heart of the canyon.
Two charges, then a pack of antlions.
Burning skulls crawl out of the southeastern rift.
The fire serpent within the rift.
The last chapter of the first book. Beyond it, the outer ring opens.
At the southern end, orcs have built a fortress.
Aim for the backs of heavy guards bearing shields.
Deep in the fortress, an orc grand chieftain in heavy armor.
The western woods are covered in webs.
Silk, Daughter of the Spider Queen
The queen's daughter guards the nest.
The queen in the deepest part of the woods.
Dead sailors have returned to the northern harbor.
At the eastern end, beasts pour from the gate.
The end of the Awakening. Stake everything.
The Throne of Doom has opened. Join the Throne Expedition with Guard Captain Hagen and defeat the lord. The lord changes every week.
